correctness.rationale: Compatibility and domination predicates give a bijection between labelled dominating matchings and closed transfer walks. A bound of six dominated vertices per selected edge and rung-spacing construction establish the minimum. originality.rationale: No identified primary result or indexed finding determines the matching-by-matching cardinality polynomial or the six-periodic explicit minimum-certificate census for every circular prism. Gorzkowska et al. Inaccessible 2011 text and possible terminology aliases leave nonzero priority risk; this PASS reflects evidence presently available rather than a uniqueness claim.

value.rationale: The result enumerates the actual minimum matching witnesses of paired domination on every labelled circular prism, not merely their common optimum size. The period-six two-valued component and quartic growth in another residue class reveal a nonobvious distribution of efficient matching placements; the full all-cardinality transfer polynomial makes the structural count reusable. The paired-domination minimum is already proved by Gorzkowska et al. (2023, Proposition 18), and is not part of the substantive novelty claim.
